source: Viavi press release: Inertial Labs, a VIAVI Solutions Company, Accelerates (10-22-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Inertial Labs, a VIAVI company, launched the INS-NV, a programmable development platform for alternative position, navigation and timing (Alt-PNT) and visual navigation systems that combines an inertial navigation system (INS), an attitude and heading reference system (AHRS) and an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX edge AI module with tactical-grade MEMS sensors and a full-constellation GNSS receiver; it is available immediately, with MAVLink, ASPN-, pntOS- and MOSA-compliant variants on request.
